targets.authors: Mapstone M, Cheema AK, Fiandaca MS, Zhong X, Mhyre TR, MacArthur LH, et al.
targets.title: Plasma phospholipids identify antecedent memory impairment in older adults
targets.evidence_quote: In this report, we first attempted to confirm the index findings by Mapstone et al. using the same metabolomics platform and analytical methodology used in their report.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, we were unable to replicate the high prediction performance for detecting preclinical AD reported previously for a metabolite panel assayed on the same platform using a substantially larger sample size drawn from two independent well-characterized longitudinal cohorts.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict covers both independent cohorts.

reasoning: Two new independent cohort samples re-test the predictive performance of Mapstone et al.’s 10-metabolite panel. Exploratory identification of other metabolites does not supply another original target. Other cited failed biomarker studies and matrix-comparison studies are contextual.
